field: song_id (all pages) where song_id is in spotify.show_liked_songs[].song_id AND in spotify.show_downloaded_songs[].song_id; kept, never passed to an API
song_id (all pages) where song_id is in spotify.show_liked_songs[].song_id but NOT in spotify.show_downloaded_songs[].song_id; one removal call per such song
song_id (all pages) where song_id is in spotify.show_downloaded_songs[].song_id but NOT in spotify.show_liked_songs[].song_id; one removal call per such song
song_id (all pages) where song_id is neither in spotify.show_liked_songs[].song_id nor in spotify.show_downloaded_songs[].song_id; one removal call per such song
album_id (all pages) where album_id is in spotify.show_liked_albums[].album_id AND every entry of the album's song_ids is in spotify.show_downloaded_songs[].song_id; kept, never passed to an API
album_id (all pages) where album_id is in spotify.show_liked_albums[].album_id but some entry of song_ids is NOT in spotify.show_downloaded_songs[].song_id; one removal call per such album
album_id (all pages) where album_id is NOT in spotify.show_liked_albums[].album_id; one removal call per such album
